subject.title: fix(ci): bound actionlint downloads in workflow sanity

question: Should this timeout hardening land independently before https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108444, or should the actionlint installer work be consolidated first?
rationale: Both PRs edit the same actionlint installation owner but solve distinct availability failures, and the preferred installer path determines whether these curl deadlines remain applicable.

options.title: Land this hardening first
options.body: After real transfer proof is added, merge this narrow current-main fix and rebase the actionlint deadlock PR so it deliberately preserves or removes the curl path.

options.title: Consolidate installer changes
options.body: Pause this PR and fold the timeout requirement into the maintainer-owned actionlint installer change if that path will land promptly.

recommendation.title: Land this hardening first
recommendation.body: After real transfer proof is added, merge this narrow current-main fix and rebase the actionlint deadlock PR so it deliberately preserves or removes the curl path.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the overlapping maintainer-labeled actionlint installer PR and can resolve the final installation path.
